blurb: Guests fish for species like Rainbow Trout, Lake Trout, Brown Trout, and salmon on Lake Michigan. Trips are aboard a 31-foot Tiara 3100 with twin 454 HP engines, featuring a below deck cabin and full bathroom. Fishing trips range from 5 to 8 hours dock-to-dock with all fishing gear included.

quotes.author: Anthony Falco III
quotes.text: This is the charter you want for Lake Michigan fishing. My charter almost had to be canceled with weather and Captain Brent worked great with me via text and calls to keep me updated with what we would do and he didn’t fluff up the odds of the trip. Once we got on the water I’ve never seen a guy move so fast to setup in such an efficient and detailed manner. This guy knows his stuff. We caught 21 of our 25 limit as a group of 5 and had a blast with the captain. It’s worth the money
